test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.

“We will wait for you if you are late,” they said to me on the telephone.

options.text: They told me on the telephone that they would wait for me if I am late.
They told me on the telephone that they would wait for me if I was late.
They said to me on the telephone that we will wait for you if you are late.
They said to me on the telephone that they will wait for me if you were late.

solution:
The correct answer is **'They told me on the telephone that they would wait for me if I was late'.**

• To **convert from direct to indirect speech**, there are **some basic rules** that we need to **follow**:

 
 
• **'Said to'** will be converted into **'told'**.
 
• **Inverted commas (,")** needs to be **removed **and **use 'that'** in the same place.
